questions.stem: A patient has a complete lesion of the right optic nerve. When light is shone into the right eye, neither pupil constricts. When light is shone into the left eye, both pupils constrict normally. Which structure is most likely damaged?

option_why.B: left CN III เสียตาซ้ายจะหดไม่ได้ แต่ที่นี่ปกติ
option_why.C: ✓ afferent ขวาเสียทำให้ไม่มีสัญญาณไป pretectal

optic nerve ขวาไม่ส่งสัญญาณไป pretectal
